name: cold-cache
description: Warns above the prompt when a conversation's prompt cache has gone cold, and offers a Haiku-written handoff or compaction instead of an expensive uncached re-read.

thresholdMinutes.title: Idle minutes before the cache counts as cold
thresholdMinutes.description: Match your prompt cache TTL: 60 for a 1-hour cache, 5 for the default 5-minute cache.
